mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_welfare_contribution ( contribution_id, user_id, date, hug_count, contribution_value, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{contributionId}, #{userId}, #{date}, #{hugCount}, #{contributionValue}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hug_count = hug_count + #{hugCount}, contribution_value = contribution_value + #{contributionValue}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS rank FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(contribution_value) AS total_contribution FROM hm_welfare_contribution GROUP BY user_id ) AS user_contributions WHERE total_contribution > ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(contribution_value), 0) FROM hm_welfare_contribution WHERE user_id = #{userId} )
SELECT * FROM hm_welfare_achievement WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY unlocked_at DESC
SELECT * FROM hm_welfare_story WHERE is_published = 1 ORDER BY help_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hm_welfare_story WHERE is_published = 1
SELECT * FROM hm_welfare_platform_stats ORDER BY stat_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_welfare_platform_stats ( stat_date, total_platform_hugs, total_welfare_value, helped_families_count, current_month_hugs, realtime_contributors, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statDate}, #{totalPlatformHugs}, #{totalWelfareValue}, #{helpedFamiliesCount}, #{currentMonthHugs}, #{realtimeContributors}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_platform_hugs = #{totalPlatformHugs}, total_welfare_value = #{totalWelfareValue}, helped_families_count = #{helpedFamiliesCount}, current_month_hugs = #{currentMonthHugs}, realtime_contributors = #{realtimeContributors}, update_time = NOW()
